{"name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Authors Verse fields on a Widget Blueprint and binds widget properties to them via MVVM. Covers
listing, adding, editing, removing, and duplicating fields, plus creating the view binding that
drives a widget property from a field's value.","tools":[{"description":"Removes a Verse field by name. Recompiles. Not supported during PIE.","name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.RemoveVerseField","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"widgetBlueprint":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint","description":"Target widget blueprint.","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]},"fieldName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the field to remove."}},"required":["widgetBlueprint","fieldName"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean","description":"True on success; false with a script error on failure."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Lists the Verse-authored fields on a Widget Blueprint.","name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.ListVerseFields","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"widgetBlueprint":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint","description":"The widget blueprint to inspect.","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]}},"required":["widgetBlueprint"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"VerseFieldInfo","type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string"},"defaultValue":{"type":"string","description":"usually one of bool/int/float/string/color/color_alpha/texture/material/message/event; an unrecognized pin type falls back to UE's raw pin-category name"},"visibility":{"type":"string","title":"EAccessSpecifier","enum":["Public","Internal","Protected","Private","Scoped","Unset"]},"writeAccess":{"type":"string","title":"EAccessSpecifier","enum":["Public","Internal","Protected","Private","Scoped","Unset"]},"bIsVar":{"type":"boolean"},"bIsEvent":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["name","type","defaultValue","visibility","writeAccess","bIsVar","bIsEvent"]},"description":"One entry per Verse field (name, type keyword, default, access, mutability)."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Edits an existing Verse field (retype/default/access/mutability). Recompiles. Not supported during PIE.","name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.EditVerseField","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"widgetBlueprint":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint","description":"Target widget blueprint.","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]},"fieldName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the existing field to edit."},"newType":{"type":"string","description":"One of: bool, int, float, string, color, color_alpha, texture, material, message."},"newDefaultValue":{"type":"string","description":"Optional string default (empty for none)."},"visibility":{"type":"string","title":"EAccessSpecifier","enum":["Public","Internal","Protected","Private","Scoped","Unset"],"description":"Verse read access (Public/Internal/Protected/Private)."},"writeAccess":{"type":"string","description":"Verse write access as a specifier string: "" inherits Visibility; otherwise one of "<public>", "<internal>", "<protected>", "<private>", "<scoped>"."},"bIsVar":{"type":"boolean","description":"True = mutable `var`, false = immutable."},"newName":{"type":"string","description":"When non-empty, renames the field to this name."}},"required":["widgetBlueprint","fieldName","newType","newDefaultValue","visibility","writeAccess","bIsVar","newName"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean","description":"True on success; false with a script error on failure."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Duplicates a Verse field under a new name. Recompiles. Not supported during PIE.","name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.DuplicateVerseField","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"widgetBlueprint":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint","description":"Target widget blueprint.","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]},"fieldName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the existing field to duplicate."},"newName":{"type":"string","description":"Name for the duplicated field. Required: must be non-empty and not already in use on the blueprint. The duplicate is named exactly this; an empty or colliding name fails with a script error."}},"required":["widgetBlueprint","fieldName","newName"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean","description":"True on success; false with a script error on failure."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Binds a widget property to a Verse field on the same Widget Blueprint (the field is the MVVM SelfContext

Not supported during PIE.","name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.BindWidgetPropertyToVerseField","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"widgetBlueprint":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint","description":"Target widget blueprint (must already contain VerseFieldName).","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]},"verseFieldName":{"type":"string","description":"Existing Verse field to read from."},"targetWidget":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMG.Widget","description":"Widget in the tree whose property is written.","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]},"widgetPropertyPath":{"type":"string","description":"Dot-path to the destination property (e.g. "RenderOpacity", "ColorAndOpacity.SpecifiedColor"). Case-sensitive."},"mode":{"type":"string","title":"EMVVMBindingMode","enum":["OneTimeToDestination","OneWayToDestination","TwoWay","OneTimeToSource","OneWayToSource"],"description":"Binding mode (default OneWayToDestination = Verse field drives the widget; TwoWay for editable write-back).","default":"OneWayToDestination"},"conversionName":{"type":"string","description":"Optional conversion function name for type mismatches (None = auto).","default":"None"}},"required":["widgetBlueprint","verseFieldName","targetWidget","widgetPropertyPath"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Valid binding FGuid on success; invalid FGuid with a script error on failure.","pattern":"^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Adds a new Verse field (variable) to a Widget Blueprint. The field becomes bindable (FieldNotify) and
is reflected into the widget's generated Verse class. Recompiles the blueprint. Not supported during PIE.","name":"VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.AddVerseField","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"widgetBlueprint":{"type":"object","title":"/Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint","description":"Target widget blueprint.","properties":{"refPath":{"type":"string","description":"The reference stored as a soft path string."}},"required":["refPath"]},"fieldName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the new field. Must be a valid identifier and unique on the blueprint."},"fieldType":{"type":"string","description":"One of: bool, int, float, string, color, color_alpha, texture, material, message."},"defaultValue":{"type":"string","description":"Optional string default (empty for none)."},"visibility":{"type":"string","title":"EAccessSpecifier","enum":["Public","Internal","Protected","Private","Scoped","Unset"],"description":"Verse read access (Public/Internal/Protected/Private)."},"writeAccess":{"type":"string","description":"Verse write access as a specifier string: "" inherits Visibility; otherwise one of "<public>", "<internal>", "<protected>", "<private>", "<scoped>".","default":""},"bIsVar":{"type":"boolean","description":"True = mutable `var`, false = immutable.","default":true}},"required":["widgetBlueprint","fieldName","fieldType","defaultValue","visibility"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean","description":"True on success; false with a script error on failure."}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
